# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VOLUME_DRY_UP_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When midday volume dries to <50% of the early‑day average and price breaks below VWAP with a bearish ribbon alignment, short momentum follows due to lack of buying support. This captures a liquidity‑driven mean‑reversion edge distinct from morning rejection patterns.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** IF time between 11:00‑13:00 ET AND volume_30min < 0.5 × avg_volume_30min_(09:30‑11:30) AND close < VWAP(20) AND EMA8 < EMA21 < EMA55 THEN enter short at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Primary stop is a chart‑stop at the most recent swing high (structure high). TP1 is placed at 1.5R (risk‑reward). After TP1 fills, the remaining runner trails 12% off the high‑water mark (HWM). The strategy avoids the first and last 30 minutes of the session and is only considered when VIX > 18 (elevated volatility regime).
